newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain must ensure fiscal stability within EMU - Rojo.
newsitem.headline: Spain must ensure fiscal stability within EMU - Rojo.

text.p: Spain must ensure it maintains fiscal stability after joining European economic and monetary union, Bank of Spain governor Luis Angel Rojo said on Monday.

"The country must make an effort to persist in its policy of fiscal restructuring and must try to progress along flexible and stable paths if it wants to avoid having very serious problems once it is incorporated into a monetary union," Rojo said.

Speaking at a Banesto conference on the European single currency, Rojo excluded the prospect that the Maastricht convergence criteria would become more flexible. This would entail some very costly risks for the European Union, he said.
